rationale: This essay examines the visibility of religion, secularization and gender within the discipline of sociology and has no relation to household or community water or sanitation service access (E01).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both readings exclude this record under E01 because it is a theoretical essay on religion and gender in sociology with no connection to water or sanitation service access.

evidence_quotes.quote: Becoming Visible: Religion and Gender in Sociology
I show how considering gender and religion together enhances our understanding of both.
